page: Microsoft Azure EC48as_v6 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ECasv6 family. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD processor and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is configured with 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached storage, though the instance is designated as Premium Storage capable. There are zero integrated GPUs, making it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated graphics or parallel computing tasks. Additionally, the instance includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With its 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the EC48as_v6 offers a high-density memory configuration relative to its compute resources. This makes the instance qualitatively cost-efficient for memory-intensive workloads that do not require local scratch space or GPU acceleration. Appropriate workloads include large-scale databases, in-memory caching layers, enterprise applications, and memory-bound data processing tasks.
